title: dendranthema japonicum
intro: Dendranthema japonicum, commonly known as Chrysanthemum or Japanese chrysanthemum, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dendranthema japonicum include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties, contributing to the plant's therapeutic actions.
